guidebook.intro: Nnyonnyola ekika kyo n’omuziro gwo mu Lungereza, ng’oyogera n’abagenyi oba ku ssomero.

tips.title: Ekika kyo
body: **Ekika** kiba **clan**, **omuziro** kiba **totem**. Okugamba ekika kyo: **My clan is Ffumbe.** oba **I belong to the Lugave clan.** Okubuuza: **Which clan are you?** oba **What is your clan?**

tips.title: “Of” tekikyuka
body: Mu Luganda “-a” kikyuka: **ekika kya**, **omuziro gwa**. Mu Lungereza bulijjo **of**: **the totem of Ngeye**. Era osobola okukozesa **’s**: **Ngeye’s totem**.

culture.title: Okunnyonnyola ebika
body: Abagenyi batera okubuuza ku bika. Sentensi ennyangu: **In Buganda every person belongs to a clan. Each clan has a totem, and we don’t eat our totem.**
